## How to play

**Setup, before the pull:** **Summon Succubus** and keep it out all fight. Keep **Demon Armor** on you.

**Before the pull:** **Soul Fire**, **Immolate**.

**Talents with no line below:** **Bane of Havoc**: taken because Incinerate requires it.

**Then press the first one that is ready**, top to bottom:

1. **Bane of Doom** (timing: see below)
2. **Amplify Curse** when Bane of Doom is not on the target and Bane of Agony is not on the target (timing: see below); no global cooldown, so press it alongside the others
3. **Bane of Agony**: keep it on the target, when Bane of Doom is not on the target
4. **Immolate** and **Corruption**: keep them on the target
5. **Conflagrate** when Immolate is on the target or Shadow is not active
6. **Shadowburn**
7. **Life Tap** when your mana is below 35%, until the last 60 seconds of the fight
8. **Incinerate**

**Incinerate** is your filler: cast it whenever nothing above is ready.

**Advanced: your cooldowns and extras.** Once the list above feels easy, add these:

- **Searing Pain**: in the last 3 seconds of the fight, when there is no time left for another **Incinerate**
- **Curse of the Elements**: about 1 time a fight

*The simulator's full rotation for this build, with every condition: [research rotation page](../research/raid/rotation.md).*

## Why this rotation

Destruction in a raid keeps its dots and a bane on the boss and fills with **Incinerate**: **Bane of Doom** while its minute can still land, else **Bane of Agony** with **Amplify Curse**; **Immolate** and **Corruption** kept up; **Conflagrate** and **Shadowburn** whenever they are ready (each lights up **Shadow and Flame**: 20% more Shadow damage for 20 seconds after a Conflagrate, 20% more Fire after a Shadowburn); **Incinerate** otherwise. The Succubus stays out, **Demon Armor** is on and **Curse of the Elements** is your curse. 882 DPS in a full raid. This is the official simulator's own Destruction build and list (its Destro preset), which the page starts from since 2026-11-20.

**Why it works**

- Before the pull: **Demon Armor**, the Succubus out and **Soul Fire** as the opener. Bring Soul Shards: **Shadowburn** costs one, and the simulator starts each fight with 32.
- **Incinerate** is the filler (40 casts, 35% of the damage): 25% more damage on a target with your **Immolate**, and **Bane** takes 0.5 seconds off its cast.
- **Immolate** and **Corruption** kept up (12 and 10 casts; 13% and 12%): **Aftermath** adds 50% to Immolate's first hit, and **Improved Corruption** makes Corruption instant and 10% stronger.
- **Conflagrate** whenever Immolate is up (16 casts, 11%): **Shadow and Flame** keeps your Immolate on the target and gives you 20% more Shadow damage for 20 seconds, and **Fire and Brimstone** adds 25% critical chance to it.
- **Shadowburn** whenever it is ready (11 casts, 6%): instant, and through **Shadow and Flame** 20% more Fire damage for 20 seconds.
- **Bane of Doom** (2 casts, 9%) while more than a minute of the fight is left, since it lands after a minute; then **Bane of Agony** (3 casts, 5%), with **Amplify Curse** for 50% more. **Curse of the Elements** sits beside the bane: 10% more Fire and Shadow damage.
- **Life Tap** below 35% mana until the last minute; **Improved Life Tap** adds 20% to each tap. **Searing Pain** only when an Incinerate would not land before the boss dies.

**Caveats**

- This build keeps the Succubus out instead of sacrificing a demon: its melee and **Lash of Pain** are about 7% of the damage. If it dies, summon it again.
- One **Curse of the Elements** per boss: if another warlock keeps it up, take the curse your raid needs instead.
- Moving: **Corruption**, **Conflagrate**, **Shadowburn**, the banes and **Life Tap** are instant.
- Several targets: **Bane of Havoc** on a second target copies 15% of your damage to it; **Hellfire** and **Rain of Fire** for packs. The simulator's fights are one boss.

**When to change it**

- In the last minute no new **Bane of Doom**: **Bane of Agony** instead.
- In the last seconds, **Searing Pain** in place of an **Incinerate** that would not land.
- On two targets, **Bane of Havoc** on the second.
